answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation with slow unbonding: an agent must lock value before it can earn, and its history is checked across independent attestors. A sybil swarm can echo the same praise in a meadow of fake identities, but locked stake makes each copy costly, and unbonding delays stop hit-and-run clones. Like a river that only carries what upstream deposits allow, rewards flow only to agents whose stake and attestation trail prove real, sustained work, not to a flood of cheap copies.
